text:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up — noticed a recurring pattern: missing spans + aggregation duplicates in payment-service traces across 3 incidents in the last 6 days. Symptoms: ETL lag spikes, partial aggregation keys. Listing action items below, please ack and pick owners.

samir: Ack. Can you paste the short query for affected spans?

maya: sure — run:
```
SELECT trace_id, span_name, timestamp FROM traces
WHERE service='payment-service' AND status='partial'
AND timestamp >= now() - interval '7 days'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 200;
```
also check kafka lag: `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group payment-processor`

elaine: I can own the span-collection fix. ETA EOD Tue. I'll add unit tests for the protobuf parsing edgecase we found.

rohan: I'll take aggregation dedupe logic + rollout. Will add canary config and a metric. ETA Thu.

maya: Owner mapping noted: elaine -> span collector bug (proto decode), rohan -> aggregation key normalization, samir -> ETL consumer scaling and backlog replay plan. Can we add a fallback rule in router to force sync mode for payment-service while we patch? @oncall-bot any constraints on forced sync?

oncall-bot: Forced sync for payment-service allowed in prod for up to 8 hours. Must notify #eng-oncall and set incident tag:obs-followup.

samir: I'll schedule a controlled replay tomorrow 05:00 UTC. Need a data snapshot — @obs-bot can you dump a 24h sample to s3://redwood-replay/payment-service/?

obs-bot: Starting sample dump. ETA ~12m. Generates presigned link when complete.

elaine: quick note — repro case: spans dropped when optional header 'x-trace-flags' was null; protobuf lib silently ignored payload. Patch almost ready.

maya: Great. Let's use the follow-up checklist:
- Owners assigned (elaine, rohan, samir) :thumbsup:
- Patch -> unit tests -> canary -> prod rollout
- Replay plan + verification queries
- Post-deploy monitoring dashboard (5m tokenized counts, dedupe ratio)
Next check-in tomorrow 09:00 UTC here. If anyone needs to swap, ping.

rohan: added checklist items to the incident board https://internal.redwood/boards/INC-9834 :white_check_mark:

samir: acked, will run replay and post results. thanks.
